text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One claimed victory in the Japan 
Dirt Derby, superbly crowning herself the 
ruler of the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next battle is the year-end Tokyo 
Daishoten. There, the "top" of regional 
racing will be decided.
